reviews.title: Bugged All To Hell
reviews.text:
I just hopped back onto Upscrolled after a few months & I already had trouble logging in because it kept telling me my password or handle were incorrect but I had it written down & tried it about 6 times before resetting my password. It finally worked after I reset my password but now it’s telling me “Failed to post” everytime I try to post something. It won’t let me login without issues anymore & I’m unable to post anything now. It’s been MONTHS. I complained about the login before & it still hasn’t been fixed
  I also complained about how you can only find videos through tags or else the search only shows up users only & that still hasn’t been fixed either. It’s like you’re neglecting the app & made it just to make it.

reviews.title: Useful but..
reviews.text:
If the updates I’m about to suggest are implemented, more people will enjoy this app.
One of the key factors in making people like this app is allowing videos to be scrolled in an infinite feed, similar to platforms like Instagram and X.
My suggestion is that when we tap on a video once, it should open in full screen, and as we scroll down, new videos should appear.
Another suggestion is to let users add the sounds they use to a “favorite sounds” section, so they can easily access them later. This would be especially beneficial for content creators.

reviews.title: Awesome for freedom of speech. Not awesome for freedom of spam.
reviews.text:
I really like this app. It gives you an option of longform text, photo sharing, and video uploading without paying extra.

The pros: not controlled by censorship, it gives you a less biased view of what's going on in foreign conflict, and the three "upload" options I listed above. 

The cons: constantly being spammed with an a war-torn "GoFundMe" via comment or message inbox, solicitation for "not sex" from a sugar daddy or lonely old dude, and bot impersonation.

It's a good app, but the developers should put some restrictions on the amount people are able to spam you with GoFundMe requests. And having the option to make some videos private/others public would be incredibly helpful for amassing a following. 

Hopefully this comment will be seen/implemented by the app content moderators. I'd love to see it overtake TikTok. 👍🏻

reviews.title: Blocking doesn’t work. Needs more moderation
reviews.text:
The upscrolled app works well and has a lot of potential, but it needs more work and moderation. 

According to Upscrolled’s terms, when you block someone, they can no longer see your post or profile. I blocked someone but they were still able to see my posts and profile and even tried to leave comments. I reached out to support and only received an AI message to try again later. What is the point of blocking, if it doesn’t work. 

At the same time, there’s too many bots, scammers, spam, and hate speech.

That is what people really need because short video formats are the way that younger people are engaging with the world in the United States. Idk getting this app and not having that be the case it’s really frustrating, I won’t be keeping it.
